# lexical.ttr { #polars_corpus.lexical.ttr }

```python
lexical.ttr(expr)
```

Calculate type-token ratio (TTR).

The type-token ratio is the ratio of unique tokens (types) to total tokens.
TTR ranges from 0 to 1, with higher values indicating greater lexical diversity.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                     | Default    |
|--------|----------------|-------------------------------------------------|------------|
| expr   | IntoExprColumn | Column expression containing tokens to analyze. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type    | Description                                           |
|--------|---------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pl.Expr | Expression returning the type-token ratio as a float. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> df = pl.DataFrame({"words": ["the", "cat", "sat", "on", "the", "mat"]})
>>> df.select(plc.ttr("words"))
shape: (1, 1)
┌───────┐
│ words │
│ ---   │
│ f64   │
╞═══════╡
│ 0.833 │
└───────┘
```
